<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY internal "Entity Value">
  <!NOTATION notation1 SYSTEM "http://example.com/notation">
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
]>
<root>
  <item id="i1">&internal;</item>
</root>

      xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="schema.xsd">

  <data>Valid structure checking schema hints</data>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author-name "John Doe">
]>
<catalog>
  <book>
    <title>Advanced Parsing</title>
    <author>&author-name;</author>
  </book>
</catalog>
